sources.title: AttacKG: Constructing Technique Knowledge Graph from Cyber Threat Intelligence Reports
sources.authors: Zhenyuan Li, Jun Zeng, Yan Chen, Zhenkai Liang
sources.use: Technique-oriented graph extraction and evaluation; task differs from citation-grounded QA.

sources.title: CTINexus: Automatic Cyber Threat Intelligence Knowledge Graph Construction Using Large Language Models
sources.authors: Yutong Cheng, Osama Bajaber, Saimon Amanuel Tsegai, Dawn Song, Peng Gao
sources.use: Closest extraction/entity-alignment system; compare extraction on a common ontology rather than directly comparing published F1.

sources.title: CTIBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs in Cyber Threat Intelligence
sources.authors: Md Tanvirul Alam, Dipkamal Bhusal, Le Nguyen, Nidhi Rastogi
sources.use: CTI-ATE contains 60 ATT&CK technique-extraction examples. Proposed external test; not a multi-hop GraphRAG QA benchmark.

sources.title: Threat Report ATT&CK Mapper (TRAM)
sources.use: Open mapping tool, labeled data and SciBERT notebooks; repository describes out-of-box coverage of up to 50 techniques. Split by report and check ATT&CK version before comparison.

sources.title: Beyond RAG for Cyber Threat Intelligence: A Systematic Evaluation of Graph-Based and Agentic Retrieval
sources.authors: Dzenan Hamzic, Florian Skopik, Max Landauer, Markus Wurzenberger, Andreas Rauber
sources.venue: arXiv preprint; peer review not established here
sources.use: Directly related four-architecture comparison over 3,300 CTI QA pairs; inspect artifact and generated QA validation before adopting its questions.
